Creating a new business possibility from existing assets

Exploring how an established business could generate a new source of value.

The objective

Assess whether a major bank’s data assets could support new market-research and customer-opinion services.

Mak’s contribution

Mak led the viability assessment, defined potential business services and examined market demand and technical feasibility. The concept included customers choosing to participate in return for value.

The outcome

The assessment identified an estimated $1 billion revenue opportunity over five years. This was potential identified in the business case, not revenue established as achieved.

Source: Makarand Datar’s account.

The experience this brings

Recognizing underused assets, shaping a new offer and assessing its commercial potential before investment.
